question.text: A homogeneous ideal gaseous reaction <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>AB</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced></mrow></msub><mo>⇌</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced></msub><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced></msub></math> is carried out in a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>25</mn><mo> </mo><mi>litre</mi></math> flask at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>27</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math>. The initial amount of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>AB</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> was <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn></math> mole and the equilibrium pressure was <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>9</mn><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></msub></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> is <u>               </u> (Integer answer) <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="]" open="["><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>08206</mn><mo> </mo><msup><mi>dm</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><msup><mi>mol</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math>
